findings.finding: Each call to bind_native_identity_calls snapshots the current graph rather than validating against an original helper-module-owned baseline. A helper/scalar implementation or the validator defining-module scalar export changed after helper import is accepted as original when a later owner imports and binds its callports. The new owner and its boundary checker then attest to that changed baseline. Existing earlier owners refusing does not close the later-import path. The boundary installer similarly constructs new baselines from caller current state.
source_call_path: project_layout_native_identity imported and exposes raw helper functions/installers
later owner imports helper names and calls bind_native_identity_calls
binder constructs function_rows/slot_rows from altered current functions
owner factory captures new ports/guard, which now accept altered baseline
findings.recommendation: Capture immutable original supported roots/dependency graph and installer/checker implementations once within the helper module at initial definition/import. Every later installer call must first validate that original baseline and requested roots, including code/default/keyword-default contents and actual defining-module scalar slot; derive ports from captured originals. Keep per-owner dependency selection finite, and reject fresh baselining from arbitrary caller functions. Bind owner boundaries against their originally captured functions; do not allow reinstalling to replace an existing baseline.
findings.proof_limit: Static complete source call-path finding; no execution or native admission reproduction performed.

findings.finding: test_original_helper_graph_code_and_cross_module_export_are_sealed mutates _renewal and _closure, then always probes continuation._stage. Current continuation roots catalog_intent_native/catalog_intent_wire/native_node do not use _renewal/_closure, so those mutations are outside the graph its guard captures. The existing source cannot satisfy those subtests as written.
findings.recommendation: Either explicitly choose/document helper-wide immutable baseline validation as part of the first repair, or probe the actual renewal/finalization/physical-source owner for changes specific to those graphs. Preserve per-used-owner coverage rather than accidentally requiring unrelated dependencies.
